svg.title: Suction dredging barge — Sogdýpkunarprammi
svg.desc: A low work barge supports a pump cabin and an inclined suction pipe ending in a submerged cutting mouth.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-suction-dredging-barge","label_en":"Suction dredging barge","label_is":"Sogdýpkunarprammi","section":"01","category_en":"Earthmoving and demolition machinery","category_is":"Jarðvinnslu- og niðurrifsvélar","batch":1,"tags":["earthmoving","dredging"],"description":"A low work barge supports a pump cabin and an inclined suction pipe ending in a submerged cutting mouth.","design_note":"Hull, water marks and a pipe extending below the vessel show dredging rather than land-based vacuum excavation.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
